manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 181
text:
Page 001
001-1. WHY WERE YOU SO LATE? WHAT WEREYOU DOING AT QINGZI'S?
001-2. NOTHING, JUST GOT CALGHT UP IN SOME STLIFF.
001-3. TS/N: The raw is a little messed up, but it shouldn't be a problem since it's just the background being covered by other panels of the chapter.
001-4. JIANG HE, HOW DO YOU FEEL ABOUT HER?
001-5. 乙的啊
001-6. I THINK SHE'S PRETTY GOOD, WHAT'S WRONG?
001-7. 有没有觉得 ……很内向?
001-8. DO YOU FEEL THAT.SHE'S INTROVERTED?
001-9. 说了 生吧
001-10. YEAH, SHE DIDN'T LIKE TO TALK MUCH BEFORE, BUT SHE'S MUCH BETTER NOW. I TALKED A LOT WITH HER LAST TIME WHEN SHE CAME OVER,I THINK SHE'S JUST NOT GOOD WITH STRANGERS.
001-11. 就有 4么
001-12. DIDN'T QINGZI SAY A LONG TIME AGO THAT JIANG HE HAD A ROUGH LIFE AND DOESN'T HAVE ALOT OF FRIENDS,
001-13. AND HOW SHE'S A LITTLE SOMETHING SOMETHING,SHE JUST NEEDS'TIME.

Page 002
002-1. 学华销
002-2. IFJIANG HE IS TRYNG TRICKPEOPLE AND CHEATMONEY, SHE WOULDN'T MAKE UP SUCH A BAD LIE..
002-3. Primary school workbook
002-4. XU QING IS POOR AND HAS NOTHING, EVEN THE HOUSE IS OURS. IF THEY WANTTOGETMARRIED,THEY WONTGET PAST THE HOUSE- HOLD REGISTRATIONPART ANDEVERYTHINGWILLBE EXPOSED BY THEN.

Page 003
003-1. AND AS LONG AS XU QING ISN'T STUPID, HE WON'T BE EASILY FOOLED...
003-2. IT'S DESERVED IF YOU GET TRICKED BY ANILLITERATE PERSON.IF XU QING WAS THEONE WHO TRICKED HER, IT WOULDN'T HAVE BEEN NECESSARY TO TEACH HER HOW TO READ ANDWRITE..
003-3. IS IT REALLY LIKE WHAT XUQING SAID, FALLING IN LOVE WITH A PERSON...THAT CAME FROMTHEMOUNTAINS ANDENDEDUP WORKING IN A FACTORY? AND THEY WANT TO GET MARRIED?
003-4. I KEEP FEELING THAT SOMETHING ISN'T RIGHT, IVE OVERLOOKED SOMETHING...
003-5. JULY, UNDER THE SUPERVISIONOFXU QING, SUPERVISIONOFXUQING, JIANG HE COMPLETED THE 5TH AND6THGRADE OF "HAPPY LEARNING".

Page 004
004-1. WHERE'S THE ARMOR? LET ME TRY IT ON! QUICK!
004-2. AWESOME...

Page 005
005-1. ALTHOUGH PEOPLE ARE FREE TO HAVE THEIR OWN FETISHES,BUT I STILL RECOMMENDYOU TO GO SEE A DOCTOR.
005-2. HAVEYOU CONSIDERED MAKINGA HELMET?
005-3. NO,IT'S UN- COMFORTABLE TO WEAR AND IT WILLMESS UP YOUR HAIR.
005-4. HELP ME PUT IT ON.
005-5. IT WEIGHS AROUND18 KILOGRAMS.

Page 006
006-1. IFI WAS WEARING THIS THAT DAY, I WOULD HAVE PUNCHED THAT GUY WHO STABBED METODEATH.
006-2. ENOUGH, TAKE IT OFF, YOU'VE ALREADY GOT THE EX- PERIENCE.
006-3. COME ON, TAKE SOME PICTURES.
006-4. IF THE OLD MAN WASN'T WORKING ON ANOTHER SET, I WOULDN'T BE ABLE TO RESIST MAKING ONETOO.
006-5. THIS FEELS FUCKING AWESOME.
006-6. HAVEN'T YOU BEEN PRACTICING THAT TIGER FIST? HOW ABOLT WE DLEL?
006-7. TAKE ITOFF AND LET ME WEAR IT,AND THENWE CANDLEL.

Page 007
007-1. HE KEEPS TALKING ABOUT A PEACEFUL SOCIETY, BUT NOW THEY'RE MORE VIOLENT THAN ANYONE ELSE, AND EVEN THE ARMOR IS OUT..
007-2. HE'S JUST LIKE A KID. HE WAS SO EXCITED THE DAY HE FINISHED IT, SHOWING FINISHED TI, SHOWING IT OFF TO ME.
007-3. TCH...LET'S TEST ITS DEFENSIVE PROPERTY THEN. HOW ABOUT YOUGO GET A KITCHEN KNIFE?
007-4. AH! THIS IS GOOD!

Page 008
008-1. HERE, LISE THIS TO ATTACKA FEW TIMES!
008-2. you DO IT...
008-3. THIS GUY HAS BEEN PRACTICING HIS SWORDS- MANSHIP, AND HIS SWINGS MAKE NOISES...
008-4. SISTER-IN-LAW, TRY GIVING ME A STAB.

Page 009

Page 010
010-1. WHY THE HELL ARE YOU COURTING DEATH!?

Page 011
011-1. I hope you enjoyed today's chapter. Thank you for reading and see you next time.
011-2. To catch the next chapter at the earliest time possible, join our discord at discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx to be alerted when it's scanlated.
